entities.summary: Dr. Kilari Anand Paul is an Indian evangelist and politician. He is the founder of the US-based organizations Global Peace Initiative (GPI) and Gospel to the Unreached Millions (GUM) and has operated orphanages, including Charity City in Hyderabad. About 331 acres of 1000 acres land acquired by Paul and his brother for the Charity City was alleged to have been on assigned land and was being investigated. He was joined by Manoj Malla alias Bala Yesu in 2008, and started the Praja Shanti party that same year.
